title: Recovery 2.1-2.2 - the LaunchPad: USB, reset, the SOP jumpers
caption: USB into the XDS110 (1). J13 (4) all open for a normal boot. The logger on the user UART, then RESET (2). The jumper column (3) stays as shipped.

callouts.label: Micro-USB: cable to the PC
callouts.note: The board's only USB port, at the right edge beside L2/U2 and the XDS110's TM4C129 (U1 of the LaunchPad). Its reference designator is not legible in the photo. The XDS110 shows up as two COM ports; the logger goes on the one named User UART (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: RESET button
callouts.note: 'RESET' and 'SW1' are printed beside it; side-actuated tactile switch at the right board edge. Press it once the logger is listening.

callouts.label: Jumper column: stays as shipped
callouts.note: 'J18' printed under it; rows GND, 5V, VBAT, BRD, RX, TX, RST, TMS, TCK, TDI, TDO, BRD and 'SENSE' printed beside it. It links the XDS110 half (right) to the CC3220 half (left): by the silkscreen, TI's guide SWRU463 not checked (unverified). Row by row: rec2-2.

callouts.label: SOP jumpers: all open for a normal boot
callouts.note: 'J13', 'SOP' and the row numbers 2/1/0 are printed beside the 2x3 header. A jumper on a row pulls that strap high (likely, from the silkscreen; SWRU463 not checked: unverified). The photo shows the header is not empty but not which row a jumper bridges: check on the board. Close-up: rec2-4.

callouts.label: CC3220S (the LaunchPad's own)
callouts.note: Marking legible: 'CC3220S / M2 / TI 65I / A809 G4'. Same part family as U1 on the cooker's main board.

callouts.label: Serial flash (MX25R3235F)
callouts.note: SOIC-8 above U7, 'U8' printed beside it. The marking reads 'MXIC 25R3235F' only partly, so the part is by the LaunchPad's design, not the marking. Clip read: rec2-3.

terminals.label: PC USB (XDS110: two COM ports, use the User UART)
